description: How to get 200 numbers free (your country, your filter) to test before ordering: the Telegram link and the message to send. Nothing is sent for the user — they send it themselves.

country.description: Two-letter code of a ready country (nl, dk, gb, it, pt, at) or the English name of any other country (prepared on request, same prices).

filter.description: Which list: old = Old people 55+ — men, women or both, aged 55 to 100 (option: gender); mixed = Any age & gender — the age range and gender the campaign needs (options: gender, age_min, age_max); business = Business numbers only — shops, clinics, garages, cafés; ios = iPhone users only; rcs = RCS-ready numbers (rich cards, images, buttons); photo = Chosen by what the profile photo shows, e.g. dog lovers, garden lovers (option: interest); carrier = Only numbers on one mobile network (option: carrier); any other filter can be limited to a network too
